results.name: Standard Baseline Division (Single Qualifier)
results.description: Formal Verification: Verifies that a candidate with exactly all divisor items qualifies, while candidates with incomplete sets are disqualified.
results.details: Formal Verification: Expected only Alice. Found: [Alice]

results.name: Multiple Qualifying Candidates
results.description: Formal Verification: Verifies that multiple candidates can simultaneously qualify if both satisfy the universal condition.
results.details: Formal Verification: Expected [E1, E3]. Found: [E1, E3]

results.name: Null Result / Disjoint Relations (Empty Set ∅)
results.description: Boundary Invariance: Verifies that an empty relation is returned when no candidate possesses all required divisor items.
results.details: Boundary Invariance: Expected 0 qualified tuples. Cardinality returned: 0

results.name: Single-Row Divisor (|S| = 1)
results.description: Boundary Invariance: Verifies that division works correctly when divisor cardinality is reduced to a single tuple.
results.details: Boundary Invariance: Expected [AdminUser, EditorUser]. Found: [AdminUser, EditorUser]

results.name: Superset Candidate (Standard vs Exact Division)
results.description: Formal Verification: Tests that a candidate with extra items qualifies in standard division (R ÷ S) but is filtered in exact division (R ÷_exact S).
results.details: Formal Verification: Standard division accepts supersets; Exact division strictly enforces no extras.

results.name: Composite Divisor Attributes (Multi-Column B)
results.description: Formal Verification: Verifies division when divisor S contains multiple composite attributes (e.g., Course AND Semester).
results.details: Formal Verification: Multi-attribute divisor correctly resolved to ST1 with valid composite SQL generation.

results.name: Duplicate Tuple Elimination (Set Semantics)
results.description: Formal Verification: Verifies that duplicate input tuples are automatically collapsed into set semantics and do not distort counts.
results.details: Formal Verification: Duplicates safely removed according to first-order relational set theory.

results.name: Schema Mismatch Error Handling
results.description: Boundary Invariance: Verifies that an illegal divisor schema (where S has attributes not in R) is caught and handled with an informative error.
results.expected: Validation error and exception thrown: S attributes must be a subset of R
results.actual: Schema error: Attribute(s) [NonExistentAttribute] of S do not exist in R. Divisor attributes must be a subset of Dividend attributes.
results.details: Boundary Invariance: Invalid schema rejected gracefully via validation and division exception.
